notes.title: Mini update on June 27, 2021
notes.notes:
Update content: 1. You can set the target frame rate in the setting panel, the range is 10-200fps.

2. One click initialization character inventory.

3. AI moves more quickly, AI's shooting hit rate decreases.

4. Added function of the mod making tool.

Due to the change of settings archive content caused by this update, settings archive such as key settings and quality settings will be initialized.

notes.title: 2021.6.21 weekly plan: mod documents and mod tool
notes.notes: This week, my main work is to write a detailed and comprehensive mod making document -- Make mod for E.E.R.I.E: entry to upload, so that more players can participate in mod production, and improve mod production tools and enhance its functions. Mod making documents and tools will be uploaded to GitHub next Monday or Tuesday for you to download. If you are a mod developer, you can download a unit of version 2019.4.14 first, which is a necessary running environment for mod making tools.

notes.title: Mini update on June 16, 2021
notes.notes:
Update content: 1. Ammunition box and accessories box will produce  ammunition and accessories according to the weapons in use. The ammunition box must be able to produce usable ammunition, and the accessory box has two-thirds probability to produce usable accessories.

2. There's visual feedback when you hit the enemy.

3. Add item classification column in urea tool.

4. AI improvement.

5. Weaken Cooper.
